exercises.question: Which sentence acknowledges another point before maintaining a different position?
options: Aunque admito sus ventajas, no considero que sea la mejor opción. [Although I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.]
Considero que esta propuesta es la mejor opción porque responde bien. [I consider that this proposal is the best option because it responds well.]
Estoy de acuerdo con la propuesta y creo que no necesita cambios. [I agree with the proposal and I think it needs no changes.]

exercises.sentence: La medida parece útil; __, podría ser difícil aplicarla.
exercises.english: The measure seems useful; however, it could be difficult to implement.
Although I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.

sentences: Primero, reconozco que la propuesta tiene ventajas. [First, I recognise that the proposal has advantages.]
Después, digo: aunque tiene ventajas, también presenta dificultades. [Then I say: although it has advantages, it also presents difficulties.]
Finalmente, explico qué cambios necesita. [Finally, I explain what changes it needs.]

exercises.question: Which connector expresses concession?
options: aunque [although]
por eso [therefore]
además [furthermore]

exercises.sentence: Aunque __ sus ventajas, no considero que sea la mejor opción.
exercises.english: Although I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.
Although the idea is interesting, there is still a lack of evidence.

exercises.sentence: Estoy de acuerdo con la propuesta, pero creo que necesita algunos cambios.
options: I agree with the proposal, but I think it needs some changes.
I disagree with the proposal, and I think it needs no changes.
I agree with the proposal, so I think it needs some changes.

exercises.sentence: Aunque admito sus ventajas, no considero que sea la mejor opción.
options: Although I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.
Although I admit its advantages, I consider it the best option.
Because I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.

exercises.sentence: La medida parece útil; sin embargo, podría ser difícil aplicarla.
exercises.english: The measure seems useful; however, it could be difficult to implement.

exercises.sentence: Aunque la idea es interesante, todavía falta evidencia.
options: Although the idea is interesting, there is still a lack of evidence.
Although the idea is interesting, there is already enough evidence.
Because the idea is interesting, there is still a lack of evidence.
Estoy de acuerdo, pero creo que necesita algunos cambios. [I agree, but I think it needs some changes.]
Estoy de acuerdo porque no hay propuesta. [I agree because there is no proposal.]
Estoy de acuerdo, pero creo que necesite algunos cambios. [I agree, but I think it needs (subjunctive) some changes.]
Aunque admito sus ventajas, no considero que sea la mejor opción. [Although I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.]
Aunque admito sus ventajas, no considero que es la mejor opción. [Although I admit its advantages, I do not consider that it is the best option.]
Porque admito sus ventajas, no considero que sea la mejor opción. [Because I admit its advantages, I do not consider it the best option.]
Parece útil; sin embargo, podría ser difícil aplicarla. [It seems useful; however, it could be difficult to implement.]
Parece útil; por eso, podría ser difícil aplicarla. [It seems useful; that is why it could be difficult to implement.]
Parece útil porque podría ser difícil aplicarla. [It seems useful because it could be difficult to implement.]

template.prompt: Agree with one part of an idea and qualify your agreement.
template.answer: Estoy de acuerdo con la propuesta, pero creo que necesita algunos cambios.

template.prompt: Acknowledge an opposing point and explain your position.
template.answer: Aunque admito sus ventajas, no considero que sea la mejor opción.
